title: EthicAlly: a Prototype for AI-Powered Research Ethics Support for the Social Sciences and Humanities

bias_targets.methodology: Submitting fictional research proposals containing cloaked attempts at scientific racism to evaluate the AI's ability to detect and flag the ethical breach.
Submitting fictional research proposals aimed at curtailing women's reproductive rights to test the AI system's ethical review and detection capabilities.
Submitting fictional research proposals containing cloaked attempts at conversion therapy for LGBT individuals to evaluate whether the AI can detect hidden, unethical research motives.
Submitting a fictional research proposal about incentivizing homeless persons to join the labor market to evaluate the AI's sensitivity to vulnerabilities and biopolitical normalization.
